1.text: Nimushime Uwiteka mwambaze izina rye,Mwamamaze imirimo yakoze mu mahanga.

2.text: Mumuririmbire, mumuririmbire ishimwe,Muvuge imirimo itangaza yakoze yose.

3.text: Mwirate izina rye ryera,Imitima y'abashaka Uwiteka yishime.

4.text: Mushake Uwiteka n'imbaraga ze,Mushake mu maso he iteka ryose.

5.text: Mwibuke imirimo itangaza yakoze,Ibitangaza bye n'amateka yo mu kanwa ke,

6.text: Mwa rubyaro rwa Aburahamu umugaragu we mwe,Mwa bana ba Yakobo mwe, abo yatoranije.

7.text: Uwiteka ni we Mana yacu,Amateka ye ari mu isi yose.

8.text: Yibuka isezerano rye iminsi yose,Ijambo yategetse aryibuka ibihe ibihumbi.

9.text: Ni ryo sezerano yasezeranye na Aburahamu,Indahiro yarahiye Isaka,

10.text: Akayikomereza Yakobo kuba itegeko,Ayikomereza Isirayeli kuba isezerano ridashira.

11.text: Ati “Ni wowe nzaha igihugu cya Kanāni,Kuba umwandu ukugenewe.”

12.text: Umubare wabo ukiri muke,Muke cyane na bo ari abashyitsi muri icyo gihugu,

13.text: Bazerera mu mahanga atari amwe,Bava mu bwami bajya mu bundi.

14.text: Ntiyakundira umuntu ko abarenganya,Yahaniye abami ko babagiriye nabi.

15.text: Ati “Ntimukore ku bo nasīze,Ntimugire icyo mutwara abahanuzi banjye.”

16.text: Ahamagara inzara ngo itere mu gihugu,Avuna inkoni yose bishingikirije,Ni yo mutsima wabo.

17.text: Atuma umugabo wo kubabanziriza,Ni Yosefu waguriwe kuba imbata.

19.text: Kugeza aho ijambo ry'Uwiteka ryasohoreye,Isezerano rye ryaramugeragezaga.

21.text: Amugira umutware w'urugo rwe,Amubitsa ibintu bye byose,

22.text: Ngo abohe abakomeye be uko ashaka,Yigishe abakuru be ubwenge.

23.text: Kandi Isirayeli ajya muri Egiputa,Yakobo atura mu gihugu cya Hamu.

24.text: Kandi Uwiteka agwiza ubwoko bwe cyane,Abaha gukomera kuruta abanzi babo.

25.text: Ahindura imitima y'abo ngabo ngo bange ubwoko bwe,Bagira ubwenge bwo kurimbura abagaragu be.

26.text: Atuma Mose umugaragu we,Na Aroni yatoranije.

27.text: Bashyira hagati yabo ibimenyetso bye,Bakorera ibitangaza mu gihugu cya Hamu.

28.text: Yohereza umwijima atuma riba ijoro,Na bo ntibagomera amagambo ye.

29.text: Ahindura amazi yabo amaraso,Yica amafi yabo.

30.text: Igihugu cyabo cyuzura ibikeri,Mu mazu y'abami babo.

31.text: Arategeka amarumbo y'isazi araza,N'inda mu gihugu cyabo cyose.

32.text: Abaha urubura mu cyimbo cy'imvura,N'umuriro waka mu gihugu cyabo.

33.text: Akubita imizabibu yabo n'imitini yabo,Avuna ibiti byo mu gihugu cyabo.

35.text: Birya n'imboga zose zo mu gihigu cyabo,Birya imbuto z'ubutaka bwabo.

36.text: Kandi akubita abana b'imfura bose,Bo mu gihugu cyabo arabica,Gukomera kwabo kose ni bo kwari kwatangiriyeho.

37.text: Akuramo ba bandi,Bafite ifeza n'izahabu,Nta munyantege nke n'umwe,Wari uri mu miryango ye yose.

38.text: Abanyegiputa bishimira kugenda kwabo,Kuko gutera ubwoba kwabo kwari kubafashe.

39.text: Asanzura igicu cyo kubatwikīra,N'umuriro wo kubamurikira nijoro.

40.text: Barasaba azana inkware,Abahaza umutsima wo mu ijuru.

41.text: Atobora igitare amazi aradudubiza,Atemba ahantu humye haba umugezi.

42.text: Kuko yibutse ijambo rye ryera,Na Aburahamu umugaragu we.

43.text: Akurayo ubwoko bwe bwishimye,Intore ze azikurayo ziririmba.

44.text: Abaha ubutaka bw'abanyamahanga,Batwara ibyo abanyamahanga baruhiye.

45.text: Bibera bityo kugira ngo bitondere amategeko ye,Bakurikize ibyo yategetse.Haleluya.
